setting.description: Activates warning messages if eScholarship is down
setting.name: escholarship_down

setting.description: Message to display on all plugin pages if eScholarship is down
setting.name: escholarship_down_message

value.default: eScholarship is currently down so you may not be able to view published articles

setting.description: Message to display if eScholarship is down and publication succeeds
setting.name: escholarship_down_publication_success_message

value.default: Since eScholarship is down you may not be able to view this article now but it should be available when eScholarship returns

setting.description: Message to display if eScholarship is down and publication fails
setting.name: escholarship_down_publication_failed_message

value.default: Publication failed this may be due to problems with eScholarship.  Please try re-publishing later.
